scene.description: Close on a cream cut-paper browser-window card with a circular gauge cut and recessed into its content panel, a navy paper needle pointing into a warmly lit segment of the dial.
scene.one_idea: a self-measuring loop reading its own result

objects.state: lying flat or slightly propped, content panel cut with a recessed circular dial
objects.prop_definition: rounded rectangle of card stock, raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss with slotted address bar and punched dots, recessed content panel with a circular gauge cut into it

objects.state: pivoted at the dial centre, pointing into the one lit segment
one segment of the dial lit from beneath, the rest of the dial neutral card stock

lighting.key: soft warm key light, upper left, 3000K to 3500K, roughly 40 degrees, large diffuser, soft gradual shadow edges
lighting.fill: weak cool fill from the right, about one quarter key strength
lighting.practical: single practical beneath the lit dial segment, glowing at #FDE7C8

camera.setup: B: straight-on macro, level or a few degrees above, close enough that paper fibre and the dial's layering read clearly
camera.orientation: near-parallel to the card face with a slight rotation so stack depth reads
camera.framing: approximately 30 to 40 degree field of view, close, layering and paper fibre legible

background.falloff: darker toward the top of the frame

composition_rules.focal_position: off centre, roughly on a third
composition_rules.physical_plausibility: every object must be able to stand, lean or lie as shown
composition_rules.one_focal_group: exactly one warm-lit focal group with a single light source: the lit dial segment
composition_rules.navy_group_rule: the navy element is one object, or repetitions of one identical object in one contiguous composition; never mixed navy objects
composition_rules.navy_range: subdued navy paper only, #1A2340 to #3F4A68; no vivid, emitted or periwinkle blue

negative: Google or browser or search-engine marks
more than one warm light source
more than one navy element group
